title: Understanding Residuals
text: In an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression, the residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. Think about what it means for these differences to sum up to a particular value.

title: Sum of Residuals
text: Consider the properties of the residuals in OLS regression. What do you know about their sum? Is there a specific value they are known to sum to?

title: Exploring Mean Squared Error
text: The mean squared error (MSE) is calculated as the average of the squares of the residuals. How does this relate to the sum of the residuals?
